## UI evidence

Required when this PR changes what a person sees (`html/**`, styles, client scripts, or rendered markup). If it does not change the interface, write "No UI change" here and skip the checklist.

A UI pull request without the evidence below is not done. Reviewers reject it.

- [ ] Browser screenshots of the changed states are attached (before and after when the screen already existed), or
- [ ] Render-check output is pasted below: the command, a zero exit status, and the log or a link to it. In this repo that command is `node scripts/render_check.cjs` against pages served from `html/`, which is the headless step in `.github/workflows/validate.yml`. A link to the green Actions log for that step counts.
